verdict.rationale: Docs show scale-oriented features — async batch crawling up to 25,000 pages, background job tracking, and per-minute rate-limit headers — which support large-scale data gathering, but nothing explicitly documents spinning up many *concurrent* scraping sessions or parallel job throughput limits. Community feedback also raises concerns about lack of rotating/residential proxies for high-volume scraping, suggesting real-world scale limitations. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency/session-parallelism documentation, proxy/IP rotation for high-volume use, and independent benchmarks proving many simultaneous jobs work reliably.
